question: Cycas is an example of which of the following phylum?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gymnosperms**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cycas is an example of a **gymnosperm**.
 
• The cycas are **heterosporous**; they produce haploid microspores and megaspores.
 
• The two kinds of spores are produced within sporangia that are borne on sporophylls which are arranged spirally along an axis to form lax or compact strobila or cones.
 
• After fertilization zygote is formed.
 
• The embryo is formed by the development of a diploid zygote.
 
• In embryo two cotyledons are present.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Gymnosperms ​

 
 
• The gymnosperms are planted in which the ovules are not enclosed by any ovary wall and remain exposed, both before and after fertilization.
 
• Gymnosperms include medium-sized trees or tall trees and shrubs.
 
• Gymnosperms are mainly classified into two groups-
 
 
• Cycadophyta (Lower gymnosperm)
 
• **Coniferophyta **(Higher gymnosperm)
